Patient: Cyrus Szabo | DOB: 07/10/1954 | MRN: SYN-4679862
Date of service: 10/05/2025 | Dr. Jasper Grantham, MD (Rheumatology)

History:
71-year-old man with rheumatoid arthritis diagnosed in 2024, seen to discuss escalation of therapy. Past medical history: seasonal allergies, hypertension.

Exam:
Synovitis of the MCP and PIP joints of both hands; no rheumatoid nodules.

Treatment history:
Methotrexate 25 mg weekly was stopped after 20 weeks because of persistent transaminase elevation (intolerance).

Assessment and plan:
Assessment: seropositive rheumatoid arthritis with high disease activity, CDAI 25.
Pre-biologic screening: tuberculosis and hepatitis B screens negative.
Plan: start fictimab 160 mg subcutaneously every 14 days.
